purpose: Observe both complete kernel thread/child tables of all three fixed B02 parent edges without sending Status or Readiness and without changing the original uniqueness requirement.
preservation: The original current_baseline_guard, baseline_policy, cell_ancestry and framework_epoch sources are pin-loaded unchanged.

All seven fixed process identities plus the intermediary, roots, namespaces, held/named executable metadata, previous-deployment lineage, engine metadata and cgroup limits keep their original before/after checks.

Every complete child table is passed to the original validate_child_table. Only its exact OWNER_SINGLE_DIRECT_CHILD_REQUIRED exception is reported as a diagnostic false gate; all shape/union/race errors remain errors.
The original ten policy controls remain byte-for-byte unchanged; eight new narrow child-projection controls run before actual observation.
private_projection: No raw private baseline, unknown executable path, cmdline, cgroup text or FD target path is exported.
executable_sha256 is SHA256 of the executable path string, not executable content.
Observed child exe is opened O_PATH and only fstat metadata is read; no child executable content is read or hashed.
FD observations export numeric descriptor sets and closed known target classes; unknown targets export only UTF8 byte count and SHA256. No FD contents are read.

result_semantics.ok: The bounded structural diagnostic completed with all retained baseline/source/identity/resource gates and FD retirement successful; this is not runtime admission.
result_semantics.all_child_details_complete: Separate actual field; may be false if an observed child exited or a detail could not be completed. No stable identity is fabricated.
result_semantics.original_unique_requirement_met_both_sam: Separate actual predicate from unchanged production policy. False remains false even when structural diagnostic ok is true.

actual_boundary: No Python controls, live observations, current Main requalification or device action has been executed by this package. Later clean samples cannot identify the parent that failed in the past Ticket/London attempt.
